outcomes.description: The LMS, LXP and HR systems talk to each other, so learning lives in one place.

outcomes.title: Chosen for the strategy
outcomes.description: Platforms picked for the capability the strategy needs, not the longest feature list.

outcomes.title: Adoption, not shelfware

outcomes.title: Everything findable
outcomes.description: One place to look for learning, so people stop giving up and searching.
